lines.en: label otohaspring1:
scene otohamaya1
A silent walk through a long corridor was exactly what Otoha Okakura needed after another exhausting day at school.
lines.zh: 走过一段长长的走廊，一路沉默——这正是 Otoha Okakura 在又一天疲惫的学校生活之后所需要的。

lines.en: And while she was no stranger to hard work as she’d been working hard her whole life, she’d grown quite accustomed to her time under the wing of a predatory bird.
lines.zh: 虽说她对"努力"并不陌生，毕竟她这一辈子都在拼命，但她早已习惯了待在那只食肉禽类的羽翼之下。

lines.en: She awaited his return with less fervor than the others, as she felt her emotions came across better when reserved for the spaces between blue lines on white paper.
lines.zh: 她不像其他人那样热切地盼着他回来，因为她觉得自己的情感留在白纸蓝线之间的空隙里，反而表达得更清楚。

lines.en: But there was fervor nonetheless. And she didn’t want to accept a future in which she’d need to hunt for her own scraps rather than feasting on the leftovers not consumed by her vulture.
lines.zh: 但热切终究还是有的。而且她不愿接受这样一种未来——她得自己出去捡残渣，而不是坐享那只秃鹫没吃干净的剩肉。

lines.en: That’s really all he was at the end of the day — a man who swooped down and plucked the meat off of teenage girls who failed to realize they’ve been dead all along.
lines.zh: 说到底，他也不过如此罢了——一个俯冲下来、从那些至死都没意识到自己早就死了的少女身上叼走鲜肉的男人。

lines.en: But here {i}she{/i} was — brimming with half a life that felt more like a script and another half that felt like torn up shreds of paper strewn across the floor of a well-furnished living room.
lines.zh: 可{i}她{/i}就在这儿——满溢着半条更像剧本的人生，和另外半条像被撕碎、散落在一间陈设讲究的客厅地板上的纸片。

lines.en: How she wished for the chance and the time to tape them all together and recall what it was she wanted.
lines.zh: 她多希望能有机会、有时间把它们一一粘起来，好记起自己当初想要的是什么。

lines.en: But as the sun poured in through the glass and played hell upon her irises, she focused more on the sound of her own footsteps than the beating of her heart.
lines.zh: 但当阳光透过玻璃倾泻进来、在她的虹膜上肆虐时，她更专注于自己的脚步声，而不是心跳声。

lines.en: Until something else caught her attention.
lines.zh: 直到有别的东西吸引了她的注意。

lines.en: scene otohamaya2

The bright sound of a violin bleeding into that long corridor executed the silence that brought her comfort moments ago and, instead, replaced it with an array of feelings she struggled to immediately comprehend.
lines.zh: 一阵明亮的小提琴声渗进那条长廊，几分钟前还让她安心的寂静被它处决了，取而代之的是一连串她一时难以理解的情绪。

lines.en: So she listened closely. Music was her {i}thing,{/i} of course. And, as an artist herself, she felt more inclined to identify with abstract ideas rather than specific dialogues or pesky conversations.
lines.zh: 于是她凑近去听。音乐当然是她的{i}本行{/i}。而作为创作者本人，她更愿意去认同一个抽象的概念，而不是具体的台词或者烦人的对话。

lines.en: Those were never strong suits of hers. But {i}this...{/i}
lines.zh: 那些从来都不是她的强项。但{i}这个……{/i}

lines.en: This was something she could follow.
lines.zh: 这个是她能跟得上的。

lines.en: Not just into the classroom, where she would ultimately move anyway- but on a plane somewhere between the one we know and the one we only {i}sort of{/i} know.
lines.zh: 不只是跟到教室里——反正她最后总要往那边去——而是跟到某个介于我们熟知的世界和我们只是{i}隐约{/i}知晓的世界之间的层面。

lines.en: And, for the first time since her lips touched those she’d never claim again, her heart skipped a beat.
lines.zh: 而自从她的唇碰过那双她再也不会承认的唇之后，她的心跳第一次漏了一拍。

lines.en: In fact, it skipped {i}harder{/i} than it did that time before because, unlike then, {i}this{/i} was real.
lines.zh: 事实上，这一回漏得比那次{i}更{/i}厉害，因为和那时不同，{i}这次{/i}是真的。

lines.en: This was a moment she’d stolen due to coincidence rather than calculation. Which made stealing it okay, she thought. So she listened for a little while longer.
lines.zh: 这是她因巧合而非算计偷来的一个瞬间。她想，既然是偷来的，那就不算过分。于是她又多听了一会儿。

lines.en: Until just listening alone was not enough.
lines.zh: 直到光是听已经不够了。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohamaya3
She needed to {i}see{/i} the girl. She wanted to observe the look on her face to get a better idea of what these sweet sounds meant.
lines.zh: 她需要{i}看见{/i}那个女孩。她想观察她脸上的神情，好更清楚这些甜美的声音意味着什么。

lines.en: Because, as bright as they were and as {i}warm{/i} as they made her heart, she could tell there was something else.
lines.zh: 因为，尽管它们如此明亮、让她的心如此{i}温暖{/i}，她还是察觉到其中另有一些别的东西。

lines.en: Complacency, perhaps? Loneliness? She wasn’t sure, as both of these things were things she never felt.
lines.zh: 是安于现状？还是孤独？她不确定，因为这两种东西都是她从未感受过的。

lines.en: But whatever it was, she wanted to know.
lines.zh: 但不管那是什么，她都想知道。

lines.en: She wanted to reach out and touch the girl in a way unlike she’d touched any other before- though her experience with such a thing was admittedly limited.
lines.zh: 她想伸出手去触碰那个女孩，用一种她从未触碰过别人的方式——虽说她在这方面的经验确实有限。

lines.en: This wasn’t sexual, though. But it probably {i}could{/i} be if the offer arose, as she was so currently entranced that she’d comply with any of the girl’s desires at the moment if it meant acquiring a taste of her world.
lines.zh: 不过这跟性无关。但如果真有那种机会，它大概{i}也{/i}能变成性，因为此刻她已被迷得神魂颠倒，只要能尝一尝那个女孩世界的滋味，她愿意顺从她的任何要求。

lines.en: That was all she wanted — a taste. Of whatever this artist felt.
lines.zh: 她想要的就只是这个——尝一尝。尝尝这位创作者所感受到的一切。

lines.en: Because it was closer to {i}authentic{/i} than anything {i}she’d{/i} ever done before. And again, this was her {i}thing.{/i}
lines.zh: 因为那比{i}她{/i}以往做过的任何事都更接近{i}真实{/i}。再说一遍，这是她的{i}本行{/i}。

lines.en: She wasn’t sure how long she watched her for.
lines.zh: 她不确定自己看了她多久。

lines.en: It could have been minutes...hours...days...but probably not {i}days{/i} because the bell would certainly have interrupted them.
lines.zh: 可能是几分钟……几小时……几天……但大概不会是{i}几天{/i}，因为上课铃肯定会打断她们。

lines.en: Right?
lines.zh: 对吧？

lines.en: Or was this one of those moments she’d heard about in movies — where time comes to a standstill and nothing exists outside of one singular moment.
lines.zh: 还是说，这就是她在电影里听说过的那种时刻——时间就此静止，除了这唯一的一瞬，什么都不存在。

lines.en: She wished this would be like that.
lines.zh: 她希望能是这样。

lines.en: The violinist, however-
lines.zh: 然而那位小提琴手——

lines.en: Did not.
lines.zh: 并不这么想。

lines.en: scene otohamaya4
She opened her eyes and looked out the window, but wore an expression so {i}normal{/i} that it worked in contrast to the sound of her instrument and racked Otoha’s mind.
lines.zh: 她睁开眼睛望向窗外，脸上却挂着一副{i}再正常不过{/i}的表情，那表情与她手中乐器的声音形成反差，把 Otoha 的脑子搅得一团乱。

lines.en: {i}Does she feel anything at all?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}她到底有没有任何感觉？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Is this just some well-rehearsed classical piece she’d never heard before?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这只是某首她从没听过的、排练得炉火纯青的古典曲子？{/i}

lines.en: {i}Or is it something she simply can not fathom yet?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}还是说，那是某种她暂时还无法理解的东西？{/i}

lines.en: With so many feelings left unfelt and so many probable precious moments that had flown over her head during those late hours where she’d sit at her desk, she acknowledged this possibility.
lines.zh: 有那么多未曾体会过的情感，有那么多可能珍贵的瞬间在她伏案的那些深夜里从头顶掠过，她承认了这种可能性。

lines.en: She acknowledged how, unlike her, this girl had likely {i}seen{/i} things. {i}Done{/i} things. But {i}what{/i} things? And with {i}whom?{/i}
lines.zh: 她承认，和她不同，这个女孩大概{i}见过{/i}些东西、{i}做过{/i}些事情。可那是{i}什么{/i}事？又和{i}谁{/i}一起？

lines.en: And the fact that she’d been right there, just several desks down this whole time, was terrifying.
lines.zh: 而事实上，她就一直在那儿，从头到尾只隔着几张课桌，这让她感到恐惧。

lines.en: She thought, “If there’s been this much untapped beauty right in front of my face, just what else have I been missing out on?”
lines.zh: 她想：「如果光是在我眼前就有这么多没被发掘的美好，那我还错过了多少别的东西？」

lines.en: scene otohamaya5
But that’s the last thing she’s able to think before the girl with the violin notices {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: 但这是她在那位拉小提琴的女孩注意到{i}她{/i}之前，所能想到的最后一件事。

lines.en: : I apologize.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : You’ve seen something rather inappropriate just now.
lines.zh: : 你刚才看到了一些相当不合时宜的东西。

lines.en: : {i}Inappropriate?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不合时宜？……{/i}

lines.en: : Maya...that was beautiful.
lines.zh: : Maya……那首曲子真美。

lines.en: scene otohamaya6
: It was muddy.
lines.zh: : 它很浑浊。

lines.en: : {i}Muddy?{/i}
: Confused, even.
lines.zh: : 甚至可以说很混乱。

lines.en: : I’m not sure what it was trying to say.
lines.zh: : 我不确定它想表达什么。

lines.en: : I...I had no idea you even played the violin.
lines.zh: : 我……我完全不知道你居然会拉小提琴。

lines.en: : That’s not much of a surprise to me. Neither one of us knows anything about the other. And why {i}would{/i} we? Why {i}should{/i} we?
lines.zh: : 这倒不怎么让我意外。我们对彼此本来就一无所知。而{i}为什么{/i}要互相了解？又{i}凭什么{/i}要？

lines.en: : After today, we’ll likely never speak again.
lines.zh: : 过了今天，我们大概就再也不会说话了。

lines.en: : You’ll go back to your friends and I’ll go back to mine. And we’ll both go back to feeling things that neither one of us will ever be able to understand.
lines.zh: : 你会回到你的朋友身边，我会回到我的朋友身边。然后我们都会重新回到那种彼此永远无法理解的感觉里去。

lines.en: : I’m sorry again. That was quite gloomy, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我再说一次抱歉。刚才那番话挺阴郁的，是吧？

lines.en: : Do you...
: Do you want to talk?
lines.zh: : 你想聊聊吗？

lines.en: scene otohamaya7
: About what?
lines.zh: : 聊什么？

lines.en: : Anything.
lines.zh: : 什么都行。

lines.en: : There’s no club today, so I kind of just...came here to do what you’re doing.
lines.zh: : 今天社团没活动，所以我只是……来这儿做你正在做的事。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot there was a light music club at all.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我差点忘了还有个轻音部。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for commandeering your room. There just wasn’t anywhere else that felt right.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉占用了你的地盘。只是没有别的地方让我觉得合适。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. In fact, I’m...kind of happy you did. Whatever you were just playing was...way more moving than anything else that’s come out of this room so far.
lines.zh: : 别放在心上。其实我……还挺高兴你来了。你刚才拉的曲子……比这间屋子里至今传出的任何声音都更动人。

lines.en: : I take it that means your band isn’t very good.
lines.zh: : 听你这意思，是你们的乐队不怎么样了。

lines.en: : Do you want to sit?
lines.zh: : 你要不要坐？

lines.en: scene otohamaya8
: I suppose it wouldn’t hurt.
lines.zh: : 我想坐坐也无妨。

lines.en: : If we’re never going to talk again, we may as well make {i}this{/i} meeting somewhat special.
lines.zh: : 既然我们以后再也不会说话了，那不如让{i}这次{/i}相遇变得特别一点。

lines.en: scene black
scene otohamaya9
: So...how long have you been playing?
lines.zh: : 那么……你拉了多久了？

lines.en: : I...can’t really remember.
lines.zh: : 我……真记不清了。

lines.en: : Is it just violin? Can you play piano as well?
lines.zh: : 只拉小提琴吗？你也会弹钢琴？

lines.en: : Not very well.
lines.zh: : 弹得不太好。

lines.en: : Do you want me to teach you?
lines.zh: : 要我教你吗？

lines.en: : I appreciate the offer, but I’m fine with the way things are now.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你的好意，但我觉得现在这样挺好的。

lines.en: : Just figured I’d ask.
lines.zh: : 我只是随口问问。

lines.en: : You know...I don’t think it’s weird. You coming here to play, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……我倒不觉得这有什么奇怪的。我是说，你跑来这儿拉琴这件事。

lines.en: : Why do you think that {i}I{/i} would think that you think that is weird?
lines.zh: : 你为什么会觉得{i}我{/i}会觉得你觉得这很奇怪？

lines.en: : Just the...being alone thing. Like, I know what it’s like to feel like you have to hide your music. I kick Nodoka out of the room all the time for that. And I was always quiet about it back at home.
lines.zh: : 我是说……独自一人的那种感觉。我懂那种不得不把自己的音乐藏起来的心情。我老是为此把 Nodoka 赶出房间。以前在家里我也总是小心翼翼的。

lines.en: : Some stuff’s just kind of personal, you know?
lines.zh: : 有些东西就是比较私人，你懂吧？

lines.en: : I think you might be misunderstanding why I’m here.
lines.zh: : 我想你可能误会我为什么在这儿了。

lines.en: : I have no qualms with anyone hearing me play the violin. If anything, it’s probably the safest way for me to talk about my feelings.
lines.zh: : 我并不介意任何人听我拉小提琴。要说有什么不同的话，这大概是我谈论自己感受最安全的方式了。

lines.en: : The problem is that I {i}have{/i} them. And now I’ve inadvertently dragged an innocent bystander into them after being unable to control whatever impulses made me do this.
lines.zh: : 问题在于我{i}有{/i}那些感受。而现在，我没能控制住让我做这事的冲动，结果无意间把一个无辜的旁观者拖了进来。

lines.en: scene otohamaya10
: Why wouldn’t it be okay for you to feel?
lines.zh: : 为什么你会觉得有感受是不行的？

lines.en: : It’s less that it’s “not okay” and more that I just hate it. But I suppose feelings are an inevitable part of this curse called {i}youth.{/i}
lines.zh: : 与其说是"不行"，不如说我只是讨厌它。不过我想，感受大概是这名为青春的{i}诅咒{/i}里不可避免的一部分。

lines.en: scene otohamaya11
: You’ve got {i}that{/i} right.
lines.zh: : {i}这{/i}你说得对。

lines.en: : I often find myself wishing that this shit would just be over with already so I can get on with my life {i}without{/i} all the necessary drama that comes with just being a teenager.
lines.zh: : 我常常希望这些破事赶紧过去算了，好让我能继续过我的日子，{i}不必{/i}再承受仅仅因为是个青少年就必然带来的那些狗血剧情。

lines.en: : And here I thought you were all feeding off of such a thing.
lines.zh: : 我还以为你们都在靠这玩意儿过活呢。

lines.en: scene otohamaya12
: I’m sure that’s how it looked...what with the Rin situation and all of that. But I was never really cut out for that to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我敢说看上去是那样……毕竟有 Rin 那档子事什么的。但从一开始我就不是干这个的料。

lines.en: : In fact, I don’t think I’m cut out for {i}any{/i} of this. And any time I encounter one of those quintessential {i}teen{/i} moments, I can’t help but think, “Wow. I’m really excited for this to end.”
lines.zh: : 事实上，我觉得这{i}一切{/i}我都不适合。每当我碰上那种典型的{i}青春{/i}时刻，我都会忍不住想：「哇。我真盼着这快点结束。」

lines.en: : It’s kind of weird, you know? Like, on one hand, I want to {i}enjoy{/i} my youth. But, on the other, it’s all so fucking frustrating.
lines.zh: : 挺奇怪的，你懂吗？就像，一方面我想{i}享受{/i}我的青春。可另一方面，这一切又他妈的让人沮丧。

lines.en: : Nothing’s as fun as I want it to be and I still find those moments where I’m just...alone writing music to be the most enjoyable of all.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有我想的那么好玩，到头来我还是觉得那些独自一人写音乐的时刻最让人享受。

lines.en: : But then I do that and I feel like I’m wasting away my high school years and it becomes this confusing, shitty paradox I don’t know how to escape from.
lines.zh: : 可我那么做的时候，又觉得自己在虚度高中时光，于是这就变成了一个我不知该怎么逃脱的、混乱又糟糕的悖论。

lines.en: scene otohamaya13
: But you helped me with that just now. So thanks.
lines.zh: : 但你刚才帮我解决了这个。所以，谢谢。

lines.en: : Listening to you play was the first time in a while that I’ve felt any peace.
lines.zh: : 听你拉琴，是我这段时间以来第一次感到平静。

lines.en: scene otohamaya14
: It’s the opposite for me, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 对我来说恰恰相反，很遗憾。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that I feel no peace at all right now. And, without divulging any of the specifics to you, this is the most conflicted I’ve felt in a long time.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我现在一点都不平静。而且，具体细节我就不跟你说了，这是我很长时间以来感到最矛盾的一次。

lines.en: : Is that what you were trying to get across with the violin?
lines.zh: : 那就是你想用小提琴传达的东西吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. I’m not really sure.
lines.zh: : 也许是吧。我也说不准。

lines.en: : I think I was just hoping a certain someone would hear it. But of course that would have been too cliché to actually happen and now I’ve gone and wasted the big, emotional moment on another heroine instead.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我只是希望某个特定的人能听见。当然了，那种事真要发生就太老套了，结果我倒好，把这盛大的感情戏浪费在了另一位女主角身上。

lines.en: : Well, your sacrifice won’t go unappreciated. I kind of needed something like this. I just didn’t really expect you of all people to be at the forefront of that.
lines.zh: : 放心，你的牺牲不会白费的。我正好需要这样的东西。只是我真没想到，站在最前面的会是你。

lines.en: scene otohamaya15
: And I can’t say having {i}you{/i} walk in on me was anywhere on my bingo card.
lines.zh: : 而我也得说，被{i}你{/i}撞见，完全不在我的宾果卡上。

lines.en: : You must not be very good at bingo, then. I come here more often than anyone, you know.
lines.zh: : 那你的宾果一定玩得很烂。我来这儿的次数比谁都多，你知道的。

lines.en: : I’ll keep that in mind the next time I have an overwhelming urge to play the violin.
lines.zh: : 下次我再忍不住想拉小提琴的时候，会记住这点的。

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to come by even {i}more{/i} often then. I wouldn’t want to miss another chance to hear you.
lines.zh: : 那我以后会来得{i}更{/i}勤。我可不想再错过一次听你拉琴的机会。

lines.en: : Interesting...
lines.zh: : 有意思……

lines.en: : Interesting?
lines.zh: : 有意思？

lines.en: : It's just, if I didn’t know any better...I’d think you were {i}flirting{/i} with me right now, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 只是，如果我没有会错意的话……我会以为你这是在{i}撩{/i}我呢，Otoha。

lines.en: : Hey, nobody said two heroines can’t end up together. Maybe your big, emotional moment wasn’t wasted at all?
lines.zh: : 嘿，又没人说两位女主角不能在一起。也许你那盛大的感情戏根本没浪费？

lines.en: : Ahh, I see. So apparently I {i}don’t{/i} know any better and you {i}are{/i} flirting with me right now.
lines.zh: : 啊，我明白了。看来我还{i}真{/i}是会错了意，你{i}确实{/i}在撩我。

lines.en: : Only if it’s working.
lines.zh: : 只要管用就行。

lines.en: : If there wasn’t already a vice grip latched onto my heart, it might be. I {i}do{/i} like the cool, asshole type after all.
lines.zh: : 如果不是早有一把老虎钳死死钳住了我的心，说不定真管用了。毕竟我{i}确实{/i}喜欢那种又酷又混蛋的类型。

lines.en: scene otohamaya16
: Alas! ’Twas not a fateful encounter at all, but one more fleeting moment of anguish in this curse called youth...
lines.zh: : 唉！这根本不是什么命中注定的相遇，不过是这名为青春的诅咒里，又一个转瞬即逝的痛苦瞬间……

lines.en: scene otohamaya17
: I get it, though. I also have a thing for the cool, asshole type. But I imagine I’m chasing after a different one than you.
lines.zh: : 不过我懂。我也对那种又酷又混蛋的类型有感觉。但我想我追的那个，跟你追的不是同一个人。

lines.en: scene otohamaya18
: I find that hard to believe given the general disposition of literally every single girl in our class.
lines.zh: : 这话我可不信，看看我们班上每一个女生的整体气质就知道了。

lines.en: : But also, don’t read into that statement because this is kind of a part of me that I’m supposed to keep secret and I’m only giving you a glimpse of it because you happen to be here when I’m most vulnerable.
lines.zh: : 不过你可别往心里去，因为这是我本该保密的一部分，我让你看到这些，只是因为你恰好撞上我最脆弱的时候。

lines.en: : I get it. And don’t worry, I’m not going to say anything.
lines.zh: : 我明白。别担心，我不会说出去的。

lines.en: : You’ve got your work cut out for you, though. Especially given {i}recent developments.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不过你有得忙了。尤其是考虑到{i}最近的事态发展{/i}。

lines.en: scene otohamaya19
: It’s everyone else who has their work cut out for them. I have a natural advantage given the fact that I’m the cutest and the smartest.
lines.zh: : 该忙的是其他人才对。我有天生的优势，毕竟我是最可爱也最聪明的。

lines.en: : And great at violin too. Anyone would be lucky to have you.
lines.zh: : 小提琴也拉得好。谁拥有你都算走运。

lines.en: : If only {i}anyone{/i} would suffice. Vice grips are a terrible thing.
lines.zh: : 要真是{i}谁{/i}都行就好了。老虎钳真是个坏东西。

lines.en: : They really are...aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 确实是……不是吗？

lines.en: scene otohamaya20

: So, if {i}you’re{/i} not chasing after the same person as everyone else...who {i}are{/i} you chasing after? It’s not still Rin, is it? Because I certainly wouldn’t describe her as “cool.” {i}Or{/i} an asshole, really.
lines.zh: : 那么，既然{i}你{/i}追的不是和大家一样的那个人……你追的{i}是谁{/i}？该不会还是 Rin 吧？因为我觉得她算不上"酷"。{i}也{/i}算不上混蛋，真的。

lines.en: : Secret, right?
lines.zh: : 保密，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course. Everything we say and do in this room will be erased once we leave today.
lines.zh: : 当然。我们今天在这间屋子里说的一切、做的一切，等我们走出去就会被抹掉。

lines.en: : Does that mean we can make out?
lines.zh: : 那意思是我们可以接吻咯？

lines.en: scene otohamaya21
: So it’s been {i}me{/i} all along. Poor Rin. But I suppose she deserves this for getting my character killed.
lines.zh: : 所以从头到尾都是{i}我{/i}啊。可怜的 Rin。不过我想她也活该，谁让她把我的角色写死了。

lines.en: : Hahah...no, it’s not you.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……不，不是你。

lines.en: scene otohamaya22
: It’s some jerk with pink hair.
lines.zh: : 是个粉头发的混蛋。

lines.en: scene otohamaya23
: {i}Noriko?{/i} Seriously? You’re a trillion leagues above her.
lines.zh: : {i}Noriko？{/i} 认真的？你比她强了十万八千里。

lines.en: : Try older.
lines.zh: : 再往大了猜。

lines.en: : Older? But that’s-
lines.zh: : 往大了？可那样就……

lines.en: scene otohamaya24
: Wait...you don’t mean...
lines.zh: : 等等……你该不会是说……

lines.en: : Kumon-mi’s very own sweetheart. The idol who holds dominion over the hearts of all.
lines.zh: : Kumon-mi 的掌上明珠。那位支配着所有人心的偶像。

lines.en: : Spoiler alert. She’s kind of an asshole in real life.
lines.zh: : 剧透一下。她本人其实挺混蛋的。

lines.en: : You have the actual worst taste in women {i}ever{/i} and I am kind of offended that you want to make out with me now.
lines.zh: : 你这选女人的品味真是{i}史上{/i}最烂，现在你还想跟我接吻，我有点被冒犯到了。

lines.en: : I take it you’re not a fan of hers then?
lines.zh: : 看来你不是她的粉丝啰？

lines.en: scene otohamaya25
: I sometimes have dreams where I strap her to a rocket and launch it into the sun.
lines.zh: : 我有时候会做梦，梦里我把她绑在火箭上，然后发射到太阳里去。

lines.en: : That seems...a little excessive. But the heart wants what the heart wants, I guess.
lines.zh: : 这好像……有点过了。不过心之所向，身之所往吧，我猜。

lines.en: : Point is, though...I get where you’re coming from.
lines.zh: : 重点是……我懂你的感受。

lines.en: scene otohamaya26
: And in a roundabout way, this means we can sort of root for one another.
lines.zh: : 而且绕来绕去，这意味着我们多少可以为彼此加油。

lines.en: : Just your goal seems a lot more obtainable than mine.
lines.zh: : 只不过你的目标看起来比我的容易实现多了。

lines.en: scene otohamaya27
: It’s those damn vice grips again. I’m telling you, they ruin everything.
lines.zh: : 又是那些该死的老虎钳。我跟你说，它们把一切都毁了。

lines.en: : Mhm...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: : But in the event that all else fails-
lines.zh: : 不过万一其他路都走不通的话——

lines.en: : If you ask me to make out again, I’m pretty sure it will count as sexual harassment and I will be forced to report this to the authorities.
lines.zh: : 你要是再让我接吻，我敢说那就构成性骚扰了，我就只好报警处理。

lines.en: : Doesn’t mean I can’t {i}think{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 这不代表我不能{i}想{/i}。

lines.en: scene otohamaya28
: Okay. For {i}your{/i} sake, I think it’s about time we leave. I don’t want you doing anything {i}stupid.{/i}
lines.zh: : 好了。为了{i}你{/i}好，我觉得我们该走了。我可不想你做出什么{i}蠢事{/i}。

lines.en: : But then I’ll have to go back to not knowing you.
lines.zh: : 可那样我就又得回到不认识你的状态了。

lines.en: scene otohamaya29
: It’s for the best, I assure you. I’m not the type of person you should want to associate with.
lines.zh: : 相信我，这样最好。我不是那种你应该想与之来往的人。

lines.en: : Oh yeah? And why’s that?
lines.zh: : 哦是吗？为什么？

lines.en: scene black
: Because it’ll make everyone else seem so much worse.
lines.zh: : 因为那会让其他所有人都显得糟糕透顶。

lines.en: {i}The day ends.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这一天结束了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But at least something good happened along the way.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但至少，路上发生了件好事。{/i}
